entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A bearded archaeologist, linguist, glaciologist and mage from the Ronom Glacier who walked with a cane and co-founded the Union of the Third Path during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: An Argivian woman and Third Path founder who became Feldon's wife.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A mage who taught Feldon magic and unsummoned killing machines during the battle for Terisia City.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: A member of the Third Path busy saving the last heap of artifacts.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who tortured Loran to learn the secrets of the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother who became interested in the Third Path's secrets and sent Hajar to besiege Terisia City.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Sent by Mishra to besiege Terisia City.

entities.name: Hedge Wizard
entities.description: A crazy hermit with green magic who lived near the ruins of Sarinth.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: A neutral research group based in Terisia City that hoped to defeat or withstand the Brothers.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group that betrayed the Third Path to Mishra.

entities.name: Yumok
entities.description: A tribe who provided Feldon with relics from the glacial meltwater.

entities.name: Feldon's Cane
entities.description: A mystical cane marked with unknown runes that was not made by the Thran; last seen when Feldon traded it to a black mage.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An artifact triggered by the use of mana, later involved in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Coral Helm
entities.description: A relic Feldon received from the Yumok.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: Base of the Union of the Third Path, destroyed in the Fall of Terisia City.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier on Terisiare where Feldon grew up and later lived with Loran.

entities.name: Ketha
entities.description: Town at the foot of Ronom Glacier where Feldon and Loran agreed to meet.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where Feldon lived.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Mishra and Urza on Dominaria.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: The destruction of Terisia City by juggernauts and dragon engines after a betrayal.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion triggered years later whose effects reached Ronom Glacier.

events.summary: On an expedition Feldon finds a mystical cane with unknown runic symbols.
events.quote: In one expedition, he found a mystical cane marked with unknown runic symbols.

events.summary: Feldon co-founds the Union of the Third Path and meets Loran.
events.quote: Feldon was one of the Third Path 's founders, and it was here that he met the Argivian woman Loran , another founder.

events.summary: Feldon receives the Golgothian Sylex and Coral Helm from the Yumok and learns magic from Hurkyl.
events.quote: He also started learning magic from Hurkyl , eventually learning to tap into the red mana of his mountain home.

events.summary: Mishra sends Hajar to besiege Terisia City, and after months the Brotherhood of Gix betrays the Third Path, leading to the city's fall.
events.quote: the Brotherhood of Gix betrayed the Third Path to Mishra, leading to the Fall of Terisia City .

events.summary: Hurkyl unsummons a group of artificial killing machines during the battle.
events.quote: Hurkyl used a magical spell to unsummon a group of artificial killing machines

events.summary: Feldon sends Loran away with the Golgothian Sylex since his lame leg would slow her; she is captured by Ashnod and tortured.
events.quote: Loran did as she was bid, but she was captured by Ashnod who tortured her

events.summary: After ten years Loran escapes (or is let go) and finds Feldon; they marry and live near Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: Loran tracked down Feldon in his home by the glacier, and they were married.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast is triggered and Feldon and Loran realize the war is over.
events.quote: Feldon and Loran realized the war was finally over.

events.summary: Loran dies ten years after the Sylex Blast; Feldon grieves and tries to replace her with an automaton before giving up.
events.quote: led to Loran's death ten years after the Sylex Blast .

events.summary: Feldon seeks out other mages to bring Loran back, meeting the Hedge Wizard with green magic who cannot help.
events.quote: But his green magic only influenced the living, not the dead.

events.summary: A black mage teaches Feldon a spell in exchange for his cane, but it creates a zombified Loran; Feldon unsummons it and the mage vanishes with the cane.
events.quote: Disgusted, Feldon unsummoned the creature before he could lay eyes on it, but by then the black mage had disappeared completely.

events.summary: A white scholar teaches Feldon that magic can only summon copies; Feldon creates a copy of Loran, says goodbye and lets her go.
events.quote: after saying goodbye to her he let the summoned being go.

events.summary: Feldon gets over his grief, shares his library, and becomes important in early magical research on Terisiare.
events.quote: Saying goodbye helped Feldon get over his grief and he lived out his days in happiness.
